title: Nawathinna! Meka scam ekak wenna godak ida thiyenawa

lines.text: 0771234567 kiyanne Orion Bank eke official number ekak nemei.
Meka number ekakata call karanna kiyanawa.
Check karanna welawa nodi ikman karanna kiyanawa.

advice: Me message eke thiyena dewal walata call, reply, pay, click karanna epa.

safe_action.text: Orion Bank eke real number ekata call karanna: 0112000100

lesson: Trick eka: scammers lage number eka SMS ekata dala bank eka wage kathakaranawa. Hamadama card eke hari bank website eke number eka use karanna.
